issue.title: test_agent_run_stops_on_a_new_item flakes under full just check when nested mypy output leaks
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1g4.1.1.4 note #6 during surface verification of epic sase-1g4.1.1.

just check ToolRun 5f4761a962676903e627a36a4d0b5365 failed this node under the 14-worker lane. Nested simulated mypy output src/unique.py:9 never-seen-before leaked into the parent extractor as NEW, and the nested run stopped with helper_error instead of new_item/unknown_item. Isolation pytest passed (0.77s call). Fail rate was not measured beyond that one full-lane failure and one isolation pass. unique.py is nested fixture output, not a source file. The surface diff does not touch known-continuation.

Closed sase-114 fixed a different nested-diagnostics leak (SASE_MONITOR_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR / tools/run_silent stage-one contamination) and is not this node. sase-j7 note #86 already records this observation; it is not a confirmed process-global leak, so this stays node-specific.
